articles.snippet: We want our balance back, but we can’t access the money to pay for essential repairs and settle an electricity bill Last November, Lloyds Bank informed me, in my role as treasurer of my parish church, that the church account was to be closed and that I should open a new business account instead. This can only be done online, but a fault with their system prevented me – and local branch staff – from doing so. articles.snippet: Al zeker 300 mensen zijn ziek geworden, omdat ze eieren aten die besmet waren met salmonella. Die zat in eieren van het bedrijf Laerco uit Geel.
